title: Not functional as is, need some modifications...
text:
Not functional as is, need some modifications.... [[VIDEOID:8fd89b6abb52d71dc05ce3f39610d7aa]] THE GOOD:
--------------
* Nice build quality. Good bamboo.
* Nice magnetic door cover.

THE BAD:
------------
* Not functional. The start of the cutter needs to be back further. The track is simply double-sided adhesive. I ripped one track out. I thought I can just re-position it, but there is an actual stop on the plastic track that prevents the blue cutter from moving further back, so I plan to cut it off. Watch my video. Ultimately, this is one of those products that make you go, "What am I doing? Why am I wasting time with this?" LOL! They need to go back to the drawing board. It's useable if you don't mind a crinkled up messy job every time. Gotta say 2-Stars.
